from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import difflib

root = Path.cwd()
def inventory():
    records = {}
    def walk(directory):
        for p in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
            s = p.lstat()
            key = str(p.relative_to(root))
            mode = stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)
            if p.is_symlink():
                records[key] = ('link', mode, os.readlink(p))
            elif p.is_dir():
                records[key] = ('dir', mode)
                walk(p)
            elif p.is_file():
                records[key] = ('file', mode, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            else:
                raise RuntimeError('Unexpected file type: ' + key)
    walk(root)
    return records

before = inventory()
print('Original inventory:', len(before), 'entries; includes hidden files and owner cache', flush=True)
source_rel = Path('skills/con-artist/scripts/context.py')
test_rel = Path('tests/test_context_line_index.py')
original = (root / source_rel).read_bytes()
owned = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.context-audit-', dir=root))
try:
    for label in ('baseline', 'mutant'):
        copy = owned / label
        copy.mkdir()
        for entry in root.iterdir():
            if entry == owned:
                continue
            dest = copy / entry.name
            if entry.is_symlink():
                dest.symlink_to(os.readlink(entry))
            elif entry.is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(entry, dest, symlinks=True, copy_function=shutil.copy2)
            else:
                shutil.copy2(entry, dest)
        assert (copy / source_rel).read_bytes() == original
        assert (copy / test_rel).read_bytes() == (root / test_rel).read_bytes()
        for rel, record in before.items():
            p = copy / rel
            assert stat.S_IMODE(p.lstat().st_mode) == record[1], rel
            if record[0] == 'file':
                assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record[2], rel
        if label == 'mutant':
            old = 'def collect(root, selectors, full=False):\\n'
            new = '_shared_collect_cache = {}\\n\\n\\ndef collect(root, selectors, full=False):\\n'
            text = original.decode()
            assert text.count(old) == 1
            text = text.replace(old, new)
            needle = '    budget = [0]\\n    cache = {}\\n'
            assert text.count(needle) == 1
            text = text.replace(needle, '    budget = [0]\\n    cache = _shared_collect_cache\\n')
            (copy / source_rel).write_bytes(text.encode())
            print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.decode().splitlines(True), text.splitlines(True), fromfile='original/context.py', tofile='mutant/context.py')), flush=True)
        print(label, 'collector SHA256', hashlib.sha256((copy / source_rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print(label, 'unchanged tests SHA256', hashlib.sha256((copy / test_rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        identity = '''import hashlib, importlib.util, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/test_context_line_index.py').resolve()
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_binding', p)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)
expected = pathlib.Path('skills/con-artist/scripts/context.py').resolve()
assert pathlib.Path(m.context.__file__).resolve() == expected
assert pathlib.Path(m.context.collect.__code__.co_filename).resolve() == expected
assert m.ContextLineIndexTests.test_no_stale_spans_after_new_invocation.__globals__['context'] is m.context
print('BOUND MODULE:', m.context.__file__)
print('BOUND COLLECT:', m.context.collect.__code__.co_filename)
print('BOUND SHA256:', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
'''
        binding = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-c', identity], cwd=copy, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(binding.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        assert binding.returncode == 0
        scratch = copy / '.test-tmp'
        scratch.mkdir()
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env['TMPDIR'] = str(scratch.resolve())
        command = ['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_context_line_index.py', '-v']
        print('NATIVE RUN:', label, ' '.join(command), flush=True)
        run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=copy, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(run.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        print('NATIVE EXIT:', run.returncode, flush=True)
        assert (copy / test_rel).read_bytes() == (root / test_rel).read_bytes()
        assert not list(scratch.iterdir()), 'Native temporary directories leaked'
        if label == 'baseline':
            assert run.returncode == 0 and 'Ran 4 tests' in run.stdout and '\\nOK\\n' in run.stdout
        else:
            assert run.returncode == 1 and 'Ran 4 tests' in run.stdout and 'FAILED (failures=1)' in run.stdout
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(owned)
    after = inventory()
    assert before == after, 'Original project inventory changed'
    print('CLEANUP VERIFIED: owned copies removed; original paths, contents, modes and symlink targets unchanged.', flush=True)
